ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >98% of the visible surface; macro-level ratio of high-intensity white to black is extremely low, restricted to localized scars and epibionts.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base pigmentation. Localized high-contrast white geometric clusters at the right distal tip (coordinates relative to lobe: top-right) and isolated white linear streaks on the left mid-lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white multi-lineal abrasion pattern oriented horizontally on the mid-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Confirmed epibiont (barnacle) colonization on the right distal tip and distinct rake-like scarring on the left lobe.
